item.subject: science
item.stem:
The diagram shows Ira's lifting electromagnet on a small crane. A coil on an iron core is joined to a cell through a switch. Iron bolts sit under the electromagnet. A wooden bead sits nearby.

Which prediction is correct?

options.A: Switch ON: the electromagnet picks up the iron bolts. Switch OFF: it releases the iron bolts.
options.B: Switch ON: the electromagnet releases the iron bolts. Switch OFF: it picks up the iron bolts.
options.C: Switch ON: the electromagnet picks up the iron bolts and the wooden bead.
options.D: Switch OFF: the electromagnet keeps holding the iron bolts as strongly as when the switch was ON.
